_comment: The composited bucket, the same file the 1.21.4 and 1.21.11 nodes carry. `neoforge:fluid_container`
is no longer a MODEL LOADER on this band -- NeoForge ships only empty, obj and composite, and the
branch-shared models/item file that asks for one throws `Unknown loader` and takes mod loading with
it -- but the ITEM model of that name is still here, which is what this is.
